notes.title: Patch Notes (16.6.1)
notes.content:
[olist]
[*] Increased the speed of acquiring gems in the early levels. The total number of gems per run has stayed around the same amount. 
[*] Daily challenges are now available without logging in. Submitting a score still requires an account.
[*] Fixed a bug related to counting word and letter upgrades for unlocks
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes (16.5.1)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Wilds are automatically used when playing with the keyboard. The default way of using Wilds still works as normal.  
[*] Added setting to invert discards (i.e., you keep your selected inputs / words when discarding) 
[*] Updated Upgrades to provide additional options costing less gems for early progression 
[/list]
